title: public-api.sh: robust to shared target dir
description: scripts/public-api.sh failed 3 times locally (batches 49, 50, 51) on the first crate: 'Failed to parse rustdoc JSON at ~/Cache/cargo-target/doc/<crate>.json ... No such file' with 'Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory' (another cargo using the shared global target-dir from ~/.cargo/config.toml). Worse, the script rm -f's public-api/*.txt before generating, so a failure leaves all snapshots deleted. Fix: run with its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR (e.g. target/public-api) and generate into a temp dir, only replacing snapshots on success. GitHub CI unaffected.
